areas.name: THE FREEZER
areas.blurb: nothing here stays where it is put

areas.name: THE QUARRY
areas.blurb: they dug under the floor and never filled it in

areas.name: THE VAULT
areas.blurb: the doors here answer to something other than you

areas.name: THE GANTRY
areas.blurb: the way out, and nothing under it

areas.name: THE LAMP ROOM
areas.blurb: every light in the depot was cut and carried out of here

map.name: First Push
map.hint: Walk into a crate to push it. Land every crate on a marker.

map.name: Two Crates
map.hint: You can only push, never pull. Line yourself up first.

map.name: Pressure
map.hint: A plate held down by a crate keeps its gate open.

map.name: Double Load
map.hint: This yard lets one shove move two crates. Line them up and walk.

map.name: Backtrack
map.hint: It drags, it never shoves. Mind which delivery you make last.

map.name: Lodestone
map.hint: It drags whatever is behind it, always. This one has to go the wrong way first.

map.name: The Long Reach
map.hint: You cannot shove. A trade puts the crate where you were standing.

map.name: The Short Cut
map.hint: It steps through one wall, never two. What is inside still has to be shoved.

map.name: Second Pair
map.hint: One shoves and one drags. Press 1 and 2 to change hands.

map.name: Hand Over
map.hint: One shoves, one drags. The crate has to change hands. Press 1 and 2.

map.name: The Long Yard
map.hint: A long way round, and only one way through each aisle.

map.name: Understudy
map.hint: One walks on water, one trades places at a distance. Neither is enough.

map.name: Slippery
map.hint: Ice keeps you and the crates moving until something stops them.

map.name: One Way Street
map.hint: Arrows take traffic one way. The long way round is the only way back.

map.name: Conveyance
map.hint: Both crates come off the belt in the same place. Order matters.

map.name: Warp
map.hint: Matching pads swap places. Crates and you use different pairs.

map.name: Gatekeeper
map.hint: Open the gate first, then let the ice do the delivery.

map.name: Runaway
map.hint: The belt sets it going and the ice will not stop it. Put something in the way.

map.name: No Way Back
map.hint: The arrow lets you through once. Finish this side before you take it.

map.name: Loading Bay
map.hint: Standing on the plate holds the gate open and holds you here. Send something else.

map.name: Relay
map.hint: Pads move you too. Watch where a push leaves you standing.

map.name: Cold Feet
map.hint: Nothing stops on ice by itself. Give it something to stop against.

map.name: The Grove
map.hint: No walls to push against out here. Mind where a crate ends up.

map.name: Switchyard
map.hint: Belts, arrows and a switch. Work out what moves before you do.

map.name: Sink Hole
map.hint: A crate pushed into a pit fills it and becomes a bridge.

map.name: Thin Ice
map.hint: Three pale squares, two crates to deliver. Spend the crossings well.

map.name: Breakout
map.hint: The cracked wall is the only door, and a crate is the key.

map.name: Deep End
map.hint: It walks on water. The crate does not, so get behind the crate.

map.name: Cold Storage
map.hint: Spend one crate on the pit, then deliver the other.

map.name: The Crossing
map.hint: The pale floor holds once. The hole under it takes a crate for good.

map.name: Short Handed
map.hint: One of these three is a bridge, not a delivery. Pick which.

map.name: East Wing
map.hint: Two floors share a storey. Walk the seam and deliver next door.

map.name: The Shaft
map.hint: Crates ride a shaft upward. Take the other one and follow.

map.name: First Gap
map.hint: Walk into the open air. It carries you to the next ground along.

map.name: The Archipelago
map.hint: You cross the gaps. The crates never will.

map.name: Stepping Stones
map.hint: A blink stops at the first ground it meets. Pick your line.

map.name: Switchback
map.hint: A switch stays thrown. Open the way, then come back for the crate.

map.name: Cutting Room
map.hint: You cannot stand in the light. Something has to be in the way of it.

map.name: Bank Shot
map.hint: One beam holds the door. The other is in your way. Only one of them wants a crate in it.

map.name: Lamplight
map.hint: The gate is watching the sensor, and the sensor is waiting for light.

map.name: Hold The Door
map.hint: A crate on the plate is a crate you do not get back. The door needs one anyway.

map.name: Cover
map.hint: The plate stands in the light. Only one of you can hold it down.

map.name: Two Of You
map.hint: One of you can cross the gap. The other has to be let through the door.

map.name: The Vault
map.hint: Four crates: one holds the plate, one fills the pit, two score.

map.name: The Yard
map.hint: Four floors, one yard. The marker is in the far corner of it.

map.name: The Lookout
map.hint: The light does not harm one of you. Send that one across.

map.name: Lantern Watch
map.hint: The sensor wants light on it, and the lamp is the only light there is.

map.name: The Long Shift
map.hint: One of these four is a bridge, one holds a door, and two are deliveries.

map.name: Out Over Nothing
map.hint: The gap is yours alone to cross. The crates need the hole filled.

map.name: Shaded Crossing
map.hint: You cannot land in the light. Put something in the way of it first.

map.name: Lamplighter
map.hint: The lamp is out of reach of the pad. The ice decides where it stops.

map.name: Dead Weight
map.hint: A braced step holds. An empty handed one goes where the ice sends it.

map.name: Through The Cracks
map.hint: One wall is a step to you and to nothing else. What is behind it has to leave another way.

map.name: Signed For
map.hint: Something is standing in the light. You are the one who never has to stand where it was.

map.name: Freight Only
map.hint: The pads take freight and nothing else. You will need the hole filled.

map.name: One Way In
map.hint: The arrow lets you in and not back out. The trade is the only way to finish, and it leaves you in there.

map.name: Wading Light
map.hint: The lamp is on the far bank and the door is on this one. Only you can cross.

map.name: A Thing To Carry
map.hint: SPACE lifts a gem and seats it in a plinth

map.name: The Red Lamp
map.hint: Stand in what the stone throws

map.name: Through Glass
map.hint: Light crosses the pane. You do not.

map.name: Stained
map.hint: The lens changes what the beam is for

map.name: Both Ways
map.hint: A wedge cuts one beam into two

map.name: Dead Drop
map.hint: One marker, two crates, and a fire in the floor

map.name: On The Floor
map.hint: One plate, two answers

map.name: The Breaker
map.hint: Walk into a boulder

map.name: Amber
map.hint: The stone lends what you need to move the stone in the way

map.name: The Sentry
map.hint: Nothing gets past it and one thing gets swapped with it

map.name: Both Doors
map.hint: One plate, and the two doors it answers with are never open together

map.name: Key Work
map.hint: A door that answers to what you are carrying

map.name: Turn It
map.hint: Shove the mirror from the dark side
